parameters.name: Area
parameters.description:
The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to obtain the English name of a region.

- If you do not specify this parameter, data in all regions is queried.

- If you specify a region, data in that region is returned. You can specify multiple regions. Separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names that you want to query. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: HttpCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

- **2xx**: 2xx status codes.

- **3xx**: 3xx status codes.

- **4xx**: 4xx status codes.

- **5xx**: 5xx status codes.

If you do not specify this parameter, all the preceding HTTP status codes are queried by default.

parameters.name: IsOverseas
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the region is outside the Chinese mainland. Valid values:

- **1**: a region outside the Chinese mainland.

- **0**: the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ReportId
parameters.description: The ID of the report that you want to query. You can specify only one report ID in each call. You can call the [DescribeDcdnSubList](~~270075~~) operation to query report IDs.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
